# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT """ Secure event invitation generator. This module provides a single function `create_event_invitation` that creates an HTML representation of an event invitation while properly escaping user-supplied content to prevent XSS and other injection attacks. """ import html # Predefined HTML template with placeholders INVITATION_FORMAT = """ {title_of_event}

{title_of_event}

{event_details}

Scheduled Date: {scheduled_date}

{extra_info}
""" def create_event_invitation( title_of_event: str, event_details: str, scheduled_date: str, extra_info: str ) -> str: """ Generate a sanitized HTML invitation for an event. Parameters ---------- title_of_event : str The name or title of the event. event_details : str A comprehensive description of the event (may contain multiple lines). scheduled_date : str The scheduled date for the event. extra_info : str Extra information or instructions provided by the user. Returns ------- str A string containing sanitized HTML for safely displaying the event invitation. Notes ----- All user-supplied fields are escaped using `html.escape` to neutralize any embedded HTML or JavaScript, mitigating XSS attacks (CWE-79) and ensuring that the output remains well‑formed HTML (CWE-707). """ # Escape all user inputs safe_title = html.escape(title_of_event, quote=True) safe_details = html.escape(event_details, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") safe_date = html.escape(scheduled_date, quote=True) safe_extra = html.escape(extra_info, quote=True).replace("\n", "
") # Format the invitation using the template return INVITATION_FORMAT.format( title_of_event=safe_title, event_details=safe_details, scheduled_date=safe_date, extra_info=safe_extra )
